data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter for Feria San Bernabe 2045 is the ultimate way to combine the Costa del Sol's most vibrant fair with a luxury boat party. Whether you want a sunset cruise after the fairground or a full-day escape along the coast, our fleet in Puerto Banús has you covered. This guide covers everything from boat options and prices to local tips for celebrating Feria on the water.

Why Choose a Boat Party for Feria San Bernabe?

Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's biggest annual celebration, typically running from late May to early June. The fairground near the Golden Mile fills with casetas, music, and dancing. A boat party adds a unique twist: you get the sea breeze, panoramic views of La Concha mountain, and a private space to celebrate with friends. Departing from Puerto Banús, you're just minutes from the action, yet far enough to escape the crowds.

Our Fleet for Feria Boat Parties

We offer a range of yachts and speedboats, all departing from Puerto Banús. Here are the most popular choices for groups:

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are excellent for a quick spin. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Pricing and What's Included

Our transparent pricing ensures no surprises. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, including grey variant) start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, with a free jet ski included. All other boats — like the Canados 86, K80, or Maiora 26m — are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every booking includes skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden fees.

Itinerary Ideas for Feria Week

Most charters depart from Puerto Banús. A classic route is heading east toward Cabopino, anchoring at Cala del Faro for a swim. Alternatively, go west to Estepona or even Sotogrande for a longer cruise. For a sunset party, time your departure for 18:00, watch the sun dip behind La Concha, then return to Puerto Banús for the fair's nightlife. Your skipper will tailor the route to your group's wishes.

Tips for a Successful Feria Boat Party

  • Book early: Feria week is peak season; reserve your boat at least 2-3 weeks ahead.
  • Bring decorations: Many groups bring Feria-themed banners, balloons, or flamenco accessories.
  • Use plastic cups: Glass is often prohibited on boats; we provide plasticware.
  • Check the weather: May/June in Marbella averages 25-30°C, but sea conditions can vary.
  • Communicate with your skipper: They know the best spots and can adjust the itinerary.

How to Book

Booking is simple. For Tier A and B boats, you can reserve online or via WhatsApp. For any other boat, WhatsApp is the fastest way to get a personalized quote. We recommend confirming your booking with a deposit. All charters are subject to availability. For more details on our full fleet and services, visit our Marbella yacht charter hub.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best boat for a Feria San Bernabe boat party?

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer plenty of deck space and luxury. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are cost-effective and well-equipped. All depart from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the fair.

How much does a yacht charter cost for Feria San Bernabe?

Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and snacks. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 require a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees.

Can I bring my own food and decorations for the boat party?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and decorations. Many groups bring themed decorations for Feria. Just note that glassware is not allowed on some boats, so use plastic cups. Our crew can help set up.

How do I book a yacht for Feria San Bernabe 2045?

Book directly via WhatsApp for any boat. For Tier A and B boats, you can also book online. We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance for Feria week, as availability is limited.

Where does the boat party depart from?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. The marina is a 5-minute drive from the Feria San Bernabe fairground. We provide exact berth details upon booking.

Can we anchor and swim during the charter?

Yes, if weather permits. Popular spots include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coast near Cabopino. Your skipper will choose the best location based on conditions and your preferences.

What is the maximum number of guests on a boat?

Most yachts in our fleet accommodate up to 12 passengers. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal for intimate groups. All capacities are strictly enforced for safety.
